extracted.name: Smothered Naked Porkchops on a bed of Noodles
extracted.description: An easy and flavorful dish. This dish is called naked because usually the porkchops are breaded.
instruction_lines: Season the porkchops with salt. Get a pan hot and sear the porkchops. Remove the chops to a plate and add water to pan. Bring to a boil. Heat a pot with water to boil the noodles. Add salt to water.
Chop the onion. Add flour and seasonings to the chopped onion. Melt the butter.
Toss the onions coating them well. Add to the boiling water in pork pan. Stir till pork water is thickened. Simmer 10 minutes. Add the porkchops into the gravy.

Allow to simmer 15-20 minutes. Cook the noodles till liquid is almost gone. Add cream of chicken soup. Stir in till heated. Add the butter. Serve the gravy on top of the noodles with the porkchops. I hope you enjoy!!!
